sources.title: EQS / PR Newswire — ETHGas debuts Ethereum's blockspace futures market with $800M of commitments and $12M seed round led by Polychain Capital (19 Dec 2025, Hong Kong)
sources.excerpt: Company release, Hong Kong dateline. $800M of initial commitments from seed investors plus unnamed validators, builders and relays. Claims 3ms settlement and 'close alignment' with the Ethereum Foundation (no formal partnership described). Team: Kevin Lepsoe (ex-head of Morgan Stanley structured derivatives, Asia) with engineers from Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank, HKEx, Lockheed Martin. Legal entity and incorporation place not disclosed.

sources.title: MEXC News / PANews — Binance Alpha GWEI airdrop for Alpha Points holders (21 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Binance Alpha trading from 21 Jan 2026 20:00 UTC+8; first-come-first-served airdrop of 2,400 GWEI per user holding at least 230 Alpha Points, threshold falling by 5 points every 5 minutes.

sources.title: MEXC News — Binance Futures to launch GWEIUSDT perpetual, up to 50x (29 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Binance Futures launches the GWEIUSDT USDT-margined perpetual on 29 Jan 2026 13:30 UTC+8 with maximum leverage 50x — eight days after TGE.

sources.title: KuCoin News — GWEI added to Coinbase listing roadmap; Binance Wallet launches GWEI trading competition (11 Feb 2026)
sources.excerpt: Coinbase added GWEI to its listing roadmap. Binance Wallet with Binance Alpha runs a GWEI trading competition ranked by cumulative net purchase volume, prize pool in GWEI 'worth hundreds of thousands of dollars', running in phases to end-Feb 2026.

sources.title: Ethereum Research — Measuring validator economics under preconfirmations: early mainnet evidence (murat, 15 Sep 2025)
sources.excerpt: Competitor-authored (Primev / mev-commit) analysis. mev-commit: ~1% of validators opted in; 8,090 preconfirmations settled in Aug 2025, 18,000+ to date; preconfs in >5% of blocks over 24h, peak 11.33% on 20 Aug. Includes a 'Kiln-EthGas' validator cohort on mainnet, but gives no standalone ETHGas figures. Results described as indicative.

sources.title: The Defiant (sponsored, written by ETHGas) — ETHGas: building critical infrastructure for Ethereum blockspace (25 Sep 2025)
sources.excerpt: Paid content. Products: inclusion guarantees, whole blocks, base-fee futures 'soon'. Quest campaign earning 'Beans' points; Open Gas initiative lets protocols sponsor users' gas via rebates hedged with base-fee futures. No partners or metrics disclosed.

sources.title: The Block — Nomura's Laser Digital invests in DeFi protocol Infinity Exchange (15 Feb 2023)
sources.excerpt: Infinity Exchange, founded 2022 by Kevin Lepsoe (ex-head of structuring, Morgan Stanley HK): institutional DeFi lending and rate trading. $4.2M seed (GSR, Flow Traders) Sept 2022 plus Laser Digital. On Goerli testnet; mainnet expected end-Q2 2023; 12 staff. No usage figures. (GWEI-01 reports it is now paused.)

sources.title: Ethereum Research — An observation on Ethereum's blockspace market (co-authored by Kevin L., ETHGas; 16 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Research post on Ethereum's blockspace market co-authored by the ETHGas founder; the retrieved excerpt contained no ETHGas metrics.

active_enforcement_action.note: No enforcement action against ETHGas, the ETHGas Foundation or Kevin Lepsoe appears in any coverage dated up to 24 Feb 2026 (GWEI-01, -02, -07, -13); GWEI-07 discusses possible CFTC-style scrutiny of blockspace futures as a risk, not an action. Regulator databases (SEC, CFTC, SFC) were not queried directly — re-check before sign-off.
